Overview.Name: Praveen Reddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120–150 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120–150 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Keep salt intake controlled to manage blood pressure.
Avoid very spicy and packaged foods.
Start meals with protein (eggs, chicken, paneer) before rice.
During social gatherings, eat protein first to avoid overeating.
Regular badminton will support fat loss and heart health.
